title: Declare and identify clock domains
statement: The authority must accept a finite set of declared clock domain identities and must report an unknown or undeclared domain as a distinct deterministic failure.

source.reference: packet.md (time authority identifies clock domains); interface-bridge.md; anchors: XVE-SYS-0147, FR-015

applicability: xverse::xcom::validation:: time authority public API; C++20 stdlib only.
verification_intent: Unit: register and query declared domains; query an undeclared domain and assert the UnknownClock outcome with unchanged authority state.
acceptance_criteria: A declared domain is accepted and addressable by identity.
An undeclared domain yields a distinct UnknownClock result and no state mutation.
Domain identity is stable across calls and supports equality comparison.
